headers.value: upgrade-insecure-requests; default-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' https: wss:; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src 'self' https: wss: https://*.googleapis.com https://*.firebaseio.com https://*.photonengine.com wss://*.photonengine.com;

headers.//: PERF: JS/CSS are not content-hashed, so the browser must revalidate — a deploy can never serve a half-old module graph. On HTTP/2 the whole module set revalidates in roughly one round trip, and s-maxage keeps the CDN serving them from the edge. The service worker layers instant cache-first delivery on top of this.
PERF: logos, icons and other static art change rarely and are referenced by stable names — cache them hard on the client.
The HTML shell is the deploy trigger for everything above, so it must always be revalidated.
